summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) reporting preliminary unaudited 9M 2026 metrics rather than a transactional event. Revenue was $16.3 million, up 65% year-on-year from $9.9 million, driven by Vault-IC demand, PKI services, nine months of IC ALPS consolidation (~$3.8 million) and initial Murcia output. Cash and restricted cash totaled approximately $463.0 million at September 30, 2026, and full-year 2026 revenue guidance was reaffirmed. No stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; this is an operational update with no deal mechanics to watch.
